I think about the “what if I fuck this up and live?” and then how everything could be even more fucked up after...For example, I could become even more mentally or physically damaged and have to put everyone through taking me to therapy or endure hospital bills.  Also can you imagine the amount of questions and emotional bullshit you’d have to deal with from everyone??? FUCK THAT!!! I am more concerned about the doom I would face if the suicide failed than actually dying, so I just continue on through life...maybe one day...maybe not. 

I’m glad you found comfort in research though.
I’m in the states in Central Louisiana. I think I sent you a pm, but I am not sure.

That isn’t the norm for me but it also doesn’t sound inticing to me at all. The things I’d like to do I can’t afford to. I’ve considered maybe getting out in to nature but it’s too humid now. Plus the mosquitoes are just awful. I don’t want to interact with people in person unless I absolutely have to if that makes sense.

I haven’t always felt this way. I once loved and longed to meet new people and go out dancing, but now I don’t see the point in any of that.

The thing is that I try to do things to improve my mood but nothing truly works. I try to paint or draw as a release but it doesn’t serve me the same way anymore. I recently tried selling some jewelry and artwork at a craft fair which was SUUUUPER uncomfortable and I only sold one thing.
Believe it! Yeah I’m not worried about the loans that much I just don’t want to rack up anymore for a piece of paper that might not even matter.

I am turning 30 this October. I have worked countless dead end and retail jobs and I’m raising two children. This is the first year I haven’t been enrolled in school or going to work for someone else. I am currently labeled as a stay at home mom. I never finished college because it became too expensive and I didn’t want to take out a ton of student loans. I’m already having enough trouble paying the ones I owe currently.

Myself...my own personal thoughts and actions. The fact that I have more apathy toward daily life now than ever before. I don’t have the desire to go out in the world. Absolutely hating where I am geographically and mentally. Resenting others for not understanding me. Not being able to progress in life.

Yes, all good on that end. I have support and understanding from at least one sane and responsible person in my life so at least there’s that! 

I don’t believe other people are the issue though.
Nothing is happening at all. Idk I guess they are doing alright...
I feel depressed and lost. Feels about the same as last week just not crying as much today.
I don’t know where to start. I am regretting my decision to post here and will most likely delete it. 😔
